title: Cross-boundary initiative bubble map and weekly stitcher for launch calendar alignment
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Stakeholders repeatedly surface mismatches between roadmap-level initiatives and weekly release windows (runtime/console/api). Current launch calendars are spreadsheet-heavy, siloed by org, and do not make cross-boundary risk or ownership visible.

Goal: Build a "bubble map" visualization and a lightweight "weekly stitcher" automation that together surface initiative timing, ownership, resource contention, and escalation lanes. This ticket covers: 1) data model and mapping rules, 2) UX for the bubble map that highlights overlap/conflicts and OKR alignment, 3) weekly stitcher that generates a proposed cadence for the Release Train taking priorities and capacity hedges into account, and 4) integration points (Calendar-as-code repo, Release Conductor, stakeholder Slack notifications).

Success metrics: reduction in cross-team launch conflicts by 60% (measured by post-launch blockers), 80% adoption of the bubble map by PM/eng leads during quarterly planning, and automated weekly stitch proposals delivered with >90% accuracy against historical capacity heuristics.
tasks: Define canonical fields for the bubble map: initiative_id, owners, impacted_surfaces (runtime/console/api), OKR_link, priority_band, preferred_window, hard_blackouts, capacity_estimate
Prototype bubble map UI (Figma) with filter controls: by org, priority, week-range, risk-level
Design weekly stitcher algorithm: input = active initiatives + capacity lanes + hard blackouts; output = prioritized week assignments + alternate lanes
Implement backend exporter that converts Calendar-as-code YAML to bubble-map ingest format
Add gating rules: auto-detect overlapping P0/P1 initiatives and flag owners + auto-suggest canary phasing
Create README + runbook for product/eng leads describing how to interpret bubbles and accept stitch proposals
Instrument telemetry: track conflicts flagged, stitch acceptance rate, false positives for overlap detection
Ship alpha to launch conductors and run two dry-run weeks; collect feedback and iterate
acceptance_criteria: Bubble map displays all active initiatives for the current quarter and is filterable by surface and priority
Weekly stitcher outputs a recommended schedule file in the same format used by Calendar-as-code repo
Automated conflict detection flags overlapping P0/P1 initiatives and surfaces appropriate Slack alerts to owners
Documentation and 30-minute walkthrough completed with PM/Eng leads and recorded on Confluence
Alpha run results captured: at least two dry-run weeks executed and adoption feedback collected
